title: The Third Form of Boredom: Profound Boredom as 'It Is Boring for One' (es ist einem langweilig)

sections.title: Prerequisites for penetrating the essence of boredom and of time; putting man-as-consciousness in question
sections.gist: Recap of the seven distinguishing points for the first two forms; the deeper boredom is the more completely rooted in time. The path runs through boredom to time, not the converse, which requires that the conception of man as consciousness, subject, person, rational being be put in question in advance as the chief obstacle to original time. The depths open only if profound boredom bores as such and attunes us through and through.

sections.title: No longer permitting any passing-the-time; the overpowering nature of profound boredom; being compelled to listen
sections.gist: Profound boredom bores whenever we silently know 'it is boring for one' (es ist einem langweilig). The impersonal 'it' makes name, standing, vocation, age, fate disappear; we become 'an undifferentiated no one,' not a universal ego. There is no example because it is not situation-bound (it can come 'out of the blue'; the Sunday-afternoon-in-a-large-city occasion is offered as non-binding). Passing-the-time is not merely absent but no longer permitted; we are compelled to listen, transposed into a realm of power over which the public individual subject has no power.

sections.title: Concrete interpretation along being-left-empty and being-held-in-limbo and their structural unity
sections.gist: §31a: being left empty = Dasein's being delivered over to beings' telling refusal (Versagen) of themselves as a whole; all beings become indifferent 'all at once,' yet do not disappear; the emptiness 'is not the Nothing.' §31b: every telling refusal (Versagen) is itself a telling (Sagen), a making-manifest; it tells of Dasein's unexploited possibilities, calling (Anrufen) toward what originarily makes Dasein possible — the singular extremity (Spitze). The structural unity: the expanse of beings' refusal as a whole + the singular extremity of what makes Dasein possible, oscillating as one.

sections.title: The temporal character of profound boredom
sections.gist: §32a: being-left-empty is temporally being entranced (Gebanntheit) by the single threefold horizon of time (respect/retrospect/prospect → present/having-been/future), originarily one universal horizon; time entrances (bannt) Dasein so it can no longer go along with beings; the determinate 'now' sinks, yet the whole expanse of Dasein's time is there 'all at once.' §32b: through the entrancement Dasein is impelled toward the moment of vision (Augenblick) — the look of resolute disclosedness (Blick der Entschlossenheit) that ruptures the entrancement and is itself a possibility of time; credited to Kierkegaard; cross-referenced to Being and Time §65.

sections.title: The essential meaning of 'Langeweile': the lengthening of the while
sections.gist: Langeweile = the while (Weile) becomes long (lang): not clock-time but the tarrying-while (Verweilen) allotted to Dasein. The lengthening is the expansion of the temporal horizon that oppresses rather than liberates, and is simultaneously the vanishing of the sharpness/extremity of the moment of vision — not the Augenblick's disappearance but the vanishing of its possibility-as-intensified, which still presses upon us as what is properly refused.

sections.title: Summary 'definition' of profound boredom
sections.gist: Formal definition: boredom is the entrancement of the temporal horizon, an entrancement that lets the moment of vision vanish and thereby impels entranced Dasein into the Augenblick as its proper possibility. The definition is read off the third form as the most essential (not most universal) form; warning against applying it to the first/second as special cases. Critique of the prejudice that the forms develop causally first→second→third; correction in §35.

sections.title: Temporality in a particular way of its temporalizing as what properly bores us; the third form as condition of the first and second
sections.gist: What properly bores in the third form is temporality as such in a particular way of its temporalizing (horizon + Augenblick), not beings, things, subjects, or objects. Reversal of the causal order: the third form is the condition of the possibility of the first and second; the 'it is boring for one' lurks in the ground of Dasein and the first form holds it down/keeps it at bay. Temporality grounds the subjectivity of subjects; hence the 'legitimate illusion' that things bore us.

sections.title: The ordinary assessment of boredom and its suppression of profound boredom
sections.gist: The everyday morality treats boredom as disturbing, unpleasant, worthless, a sign of shallowness to be eliminated by setting oneself a task. This 'hypocritical self-assuredness'/'banality' fails to appreciate two things: that attunement makes Dasein manifest, and that it does so only by arising from the ground of Dasein's essence, largely withdrawn from its freedom. The dominance of this ordinary understanding actively suppresses profound boredom.

key_terms.term: es ist einem langweilig / it is boring for one
key_terms.note: Impersonal formula for the third, profound form; the 'it' is indeterminate, the 'for one' dissolves personal name/standing/vocation/age/fate into 'an undifferentiated no one.'
Beings as a whole refuse the possibilities of Dasein's doing and acting; the content of being-left-empty in the third form.
Every Versagen is in itself a Sagen, a making-manifest; the refusal tells by refusing.
Reference to unexploited possibilities contained in the refusal; the seed of being-held-in-limbo.
The telling announcement is a calling that properly makes possible the Dasein in me; points to what makes possible all essential possibilities.
In the third form: being delivered over to beings' telling refusal of themselves as a whole; emptiness that 'is not the Nothing.'
In the third form: being impelled toward what originarily makes Dasein possible — the singular extremity (Spitze).
The utmost, primary making-possible of all Dasein's possibilities; the pole toward which being-held-in-limbo intensifies.
Time entrances (bannt) Dasein; the temporal character of being-left-empty; the single threefold horizon binds Dasein so it cannot go along with beings.
Respect (Hinsicht) / retrospect (Rucksicht) / prospect (Absicht) → present, having-been, future, originarily one unitary universal horizon.
The look of resolute disclosedness (Blick der Entschlossenheit) for action; ruptures the entrancement; a possibility of time itself; credited to Kierkegaard; B&T §65.
Dasein's resolute self-disclosure to itself for action here-and-now; the enactment-form of the Augenblick.
The while (Weile) becomes long (lang); the tarrying-while (Verweilen) allotted to Dasein expands into the whole temporal horizon.
The summary 'definition' core: boredom = entrancement of the temporal horizon that lets the Augenblick vanish and impels Dasein into it.

key_terms.term: temporality in a particular way of its temporalizing
key_terms.note: What properly bores us: not beings/things/subjects/objects but temporality as such temporalizing horizonally.
Becomes indifferent 'all at once' yet shows itself as such; Dasein is set in their midst, delivered over to their refusal.
Not a universal ego/abstraction; the personal self recedes, brought 'in all its nakedness' to the Dasein in me.
The refusal is to the Dasein in me, not to me-as-me; the impoverishment first brings the self to itself as the one who has taken over its being-there.
The ordinary assessment (boredom = unpleasant, worthless) actively suppresses profound boredom and keeps it on the surface.

claims.claim: The path runs through boredom to the essence of time, which requires putting the conception of man as consciousness/subject/person in question in advance as the chief obstacle to original time.

Profound boredom is named in the impersonal 'it is boring for one' (es ist einem langweilig); the 'for one' dissolves personal determinations and makes us an undifferentiated no one, not a universal ego.
There is no example of profound boredom because it is not relative to a particular situation; it can come out of the blue (the Sunday-afternoon city walk is offered only as a non-binding occasion).

Passing-the-time is not merely absent but no longer permitted; profound boredom is overpowering and compels us to listen, transposing us into a realm of power over which the public subject has no power.

Being left empty in the third form is Dasein's being delivered over to beings' telling refusal of themselves as a whole; all beings become indifferent all at once yet do not disappear, and the emptiness is not the Nothing.

Every telling refusal (Versagen) is in itself a telling (Sagen): the refusal announces (Ansagen) Dasein's unexploited possibilities and is a calling (Anrufen) toward what originarily makes Dasein possible.
Being held in limbo in the third form is being impelled toward the singular extremity (Spitze) — the originary making-possible of Dasein as such.
The structural unity of the third form is the expanse of beings' refusal as a whole together with the singular extremity of what makes Dasein possible, oscillating as one phenomenon.
The temporal character of being-left-empty is being entranced (Gebanntheit) by the single threefold horizon of time; time itself (bannt) entrances Dasein so it can no longer go along with beings.
What entrances is the whole time Dasein itself is; the determinate 'now' sinks, yet the whole expanse of Dasein's time is there all at once in the unarticulated unity of its horizon.
The temporal character of being-held-in-limbo is being impelled through the entrancement toward the moment of vision (Augenblick), the look of resolute disclosedness that ruptures the entrancement.
The Augenblick is itself a possibility of time, not a now-point; it can rupture the temporal entrancement because it is of the proper essence of time.
The moment of vision was first comprehended in philosophy by Kierkegaard; Heidegger refers to Being and Time §65 for its rootedness in temporality.

Langeweile means the lengthening of the while: the temporal horizon expands and oppresses Dasein, while the sharpness/extremity of the Augenblick vanishes (its possibility, not the Augenblick itself).

Summary definition: boredom is the entrancement of the temporal horizon that lets the moment of vision vanish and thereby impels entranced Dasein into the Augenblick as the proper possibility of its existence.
The definition is legitimately read off the third form because that form is the most essential (not most universal); the first/second may not be treated as special cases of it.
The forms do not develop causally first→second→third; the third form is the condition of the possibility of the first and second, which lurks in the ground of Dasein.

What properly bores us is temporality as such in a particular way of its temporalizing, not beings/things/subjects/objects; temporality grounds the subjectivity of subjects, yielding the 'legitimate illusion' that things bore us.

The ordinary assessment of boredom (unpleasant, worthless, a sign of shallowness to be eliminated) suppresses profound boredom by failing to appreciate that attunement makes Dasein manifest and arises from the ground of its essence.

interlocutors.name: Soren Kierkegaard
interlocutors.role: credited with the first philosophical comprehension of the moment of vision (Augenblick), opening the possibility of a new epoch of philosophy

interlocutors.name: Heidegger, Being and Time §65
interlocutors.role: self-citation; the Augenblick's rootedness in temporality/Dasein grasped 'in its nucleus' there, offered as external aid

interlocutors.name: Rene Descartes (the Cartesian method)
interlocutors.role: contested; the conception of man as consciousness in the Cartesian sense is the chief obstacle to original time and must be put in question
